_comment: The music of the game (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): work songs and the songs of the journeymen on their Wanderschaft, plus two rags. dev/music/fetch_music.py downloads each MIDI file from Wikimedia Commons (checking that it is still under its license) into assets/music/<slug>.mid; dev/music/render_music.py renders it into assets/music/<slug>.ogg. repeat plays a short song several times.

songs.title: London Bridge Is Falling Down
songs.about: An English nursery song about building a bridge again and again: with wood and clay, bricks and mortar, iron and steel
songs.credit: Melody traditional; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Es klappert die Mühle am rauschenden Bach
songs.about: A German song of the mill and the miller at work, day and night
songs.credit: Melody traditional; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)
songs.commons: File:Es klappert die Mühle am rauschenden Bach.mid

songs.title: Polly Wolly Doodle
songs.about: A cheerful American song of the 1880s
songs.credit: Melody traditional; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Auf, du junger Wandersmann
songs.about: The song of the journeymen setting out on their Wanderschaft, the years of travel from master to master (19th century)
songs.credit: Melody of the 19th century; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Das Wandern ist des Müllers Lust
songs.about: The journeyman miller's wandering song, on a poem of Wilhelm Müller
songs.credit: Melody after Carl Friedrich Zöllner (1844); set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)
songs.commons: File:Das Wandern ist des Müllers Lust.mid

songs.title: Wer recht in Freuden wandern will
songs.about: A wandering song on a poem of Emanuel Geibel
songs.credit: Melody by Franz Gustav Klauer (1840); set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)
songs.commons: File:Wer recht in Freuden wandern will.mid

songs.title: Muss i denn zum Städtele hinaus
songs.about: The Swabian song of the journeyman leaving his town and his sweetheart
songs.credit: Melody traditional; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)
songs.commons: File:Muss i denn zum Städtele hinaus.mid

songs.title: Im Krug zum grünen Kranze
songs.about: A journeyman's song: two wanderers meet at the inn and share their wine
songs.credit: Melody traditional (volkstümlich); set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Wem Gott will rechte Gunst erweisen
songs.about: The good-fellow's wandering song on a poem of Joseph von Eichendorff
songs.credit: Melody by Friedrich Theodor Fröhlich (1833); set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)
songs.commons: File:Wem Gott will rechte Gunst erweisen.mid

songs.title: Wohlauf, die Luft geht frisch und rein
songs.about: A wandering song on a poem of Joseph Victor von Scheffel
songs.credit: Melody by Valentin Eduard Becker (1861); set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Müde kehrt ein Wandersmann zurück
songs.about: The wanderer comes home in the evening
songs.credit: Melody traditional, 19th century; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: Winter, ade
songs.about: A spring song: the winter goes, the road opens
songs.credit: Melody traditional; set and sequenced by Peter Gerloff (Rabanus Flavus)

songs.title: The Entertainer
songs.credit: Scott Joplin (1868-1917); typeset and sequenced by the contributors to the Mutopia Project
